question: The famous festival known as ‘Paro Tschechu’ is associated with which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paro Tschechu** is a famous annual religious festival celebrated in **Bhutan**.
 
• It is a four-day festival held in the Paro Valley of Bhutan, usually in **March or April**, to commemorate the birth anniversary of** Guru Rinpoche, the patron saint of Bhutan**.
 
• The festival features colorful traditional **dances, mask performances, and religious rituals performed by monks** and laypeople in elaborate costumes and masks.
 
• The festival also attracts a large number of tourists from around the world who come to witness the vibrant cultural heritage of Bhutan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Japan** is known for its own unique festivals such as the **Cherry Blossom Festival and the Gion Matsuri Festival**.
 
• **Thailand **is known for festivals such as **Songkran (Thai New Year) and Loi Krathong (Festival of Lights)**.
 
• **Burma **is known for festivals such as **Thingyan (Burmese New Year) and Taunggyi Tazaungdaing (Hot Air Balloon Festival)**.
